name: State Core Committee
objectives: Oversee day-to-day decision-making and critical operations
Formulate long-term strategic plans for the association
Coordinate responses to urgent policy developments

name: Government Liaison & Policy Committee
objectives: Represent member interests before state health departments
Participate in advisory discussions for healthcare guidelines
Provide inputs on clinical regulations and draft policies

name: Clinical Establishment Licensing Support Cell
objectives: Help small-to-medium nursing homes with licensing compliance
Advocate for transparent, online, time-bound registration renewals
Organize educational workshops on statutory regulations

name: Swasthya Sathi & Ayushman Bharat Coordination
objectives: Coordinate with departments to resolve reimbursement delays
Streamline pre-authorization workflows for private clinical partners
Promote ethical utilization of state-sponsored health programs

name: Patient & Healthcare Worker Safety Council
objectives: Ensure robust security protocols for doctors and clinical staff
Develop guidelines for patient dignity and grievances handling
Conduct campaigns on non-violence in medical premises

name: Legal & Grievance Representation Committee
objectives: Provide legal counsel and guidance for member institutions
Scrutinize complaints and represent members before authorities
Address internal grievances between members and district committees

name: Public Relations & Media Committee
objectives: Publish official statements and manage press releases
Build a positive image of private healthcare contributions
Manage social channels and response strategies

name: District Units Coordination Committee
objectives: Facilitate interactions between state committee and district units
Set up new district blocks and local subcommittees
Review regional membership fees and collection models

name: Training & Quality Assurance Committee
objectives: Design skill programs for nursing and paramedical staff
Help clinical establishments prepare for NABH Entry-Level certification
Encourage continuous professional medical updates

name: IT, Digital & Website Committee
objectives: Maintain the official APHN web portal and member dashboard
Manage online membership registers and database directory
Integrate online payment gateways and circular downloads

name: Ethical Practices & Audit Committee
objectives: Implement a standardized Code of Conduct for members
Investigate violations of ethics guidelines or overcharging reports
Promote medical audit reviews among private hospitals

name: Health Programs & Community Services
objectives: Drive participation in national health programs (TB, immunization)
Host free screening camps in coordination with local bodies
Manage disaster response coordination when requested

name: Public Awareness & Health Promotion
objectives: Educate communities on preventive wellness and lifestyle issues
Publish patient rights manuals and healthcare resources
Organize health awareness campaigns in remote districts
